story: Hillstomp, the Portland duo of Henry Kammerer on guitar and vocals and John Johnson on buckets and a junk kit, met in 2001 and built a North Mississippi-style hill country blues stomp. They played Pickathon in 2004, a year before their debut, One Word. Portland, Ore., their first new record since 2010, came out on Fluff & Gravy in 2014 and Monster Receiver in 2018, and their music turned up in the third season of Sons of Anarchy.
artist_reel_line: Portland, Ore. came out on Fluff & Gravy in 2014, Monster Receiver in 2018.

intro: A Dublin-born button accordion player living in Portland.
story: Johnny B. Connolly, a Dublin-born button accordion player, joined the Celtic band Anam at 17 and first came to Portland on a 1997 tour. He signed with Green Linnet in 2001 on the strength of a friendship with fiddler Kevin Burke, and his debut, Bridgetown, is named for his adopted home. He played Pickathon in 2004, and since 2014 he has toured with the Irish band Solas and appears on its album All These Years.
artist_reel_line: Since 2014 he has toured with Solas and appears on All These Years.

story: Jo Miller sang lead in the nearly all-woman western swing band Ranch Romance, which made three albums for Sugar Hill and toured with k.d. lang, then formed the Burly Roughnecks around the turn of the century. The Seattle band played Pickathon in 2004. After a long break it returned to play Seattle-area dances in June 2024 and June 2025.
artist_reel_line: After a long break, the band played Seattle-area dances in 2024 and 2025.

story: The Shiftless Rounders were an old-time string band, a duo from western Massachusetts who were first based in Vermont. They played Pickathon in 2004 and again in 2005, and their live set from the 2004 festival was released on Pickathon's own compilation. Ghost in the Radio came out in 2004.
artist_reel_line: Their 2004 live set was released on Pickathon's own compilation.
